title: Made an Granny Like horror game in 2 hours
author: Infinite_Ad_9204
selftext:
So I saw on the internet about some spooky game jam, asked my claude to make an horror game, similar to granny game, the result was really outstanding for me, I could not believe, then I asked yo make a youtube video about how he made the game posting video here.

Btw i just switched form 10 years of unity development to web + claude development, haven't written 1 line of code after that, love new pipelines, planning to make lot's of tutorials 

I'm using claude + tripo + some bought assets from asset stores

Ask me anything about my pipeline or anything you want to know about gamedev! Will share all information in comments.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PU1Fy4shKCM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PU1Fy4shKCM)

comments.author: Infinite_Ad_9204
comments.body: btw about video, the whole video is made by claude also. Can write more detailed about pipeline of making video from the game if anybody wants

replies.author: Happy_Variety5405
replies.body: Everyone can tell mate.  Millions of Ai videos are generated every day and thousands of them uploaded every day on YouTube. Nothing about your pipeline is unique

replies.author: Infinite_Ad_9204
replies.body: in that case I will ask you to share some interesting stuff to learn from

comments.author: -svde-
comments.body:
claude said it would take two days under the assumption that you would be building and working on it. that’s what those time estimates mean. in no world would a game like this take 2-3 days especially with opus 5.5. 

you just started using these tools, but you are posting this on an AI game dev sub. just saying don’t get your hopes up on making a bunch of tutorials and them being useful for a lot of people
